justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Small studies positive for posture and pain; effect sizes modest. No high-quality RCTs.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 760+ hour training over 1-2 years; significant time and cost investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to posture, movement dysfunction, and chronic pain; limited practitioner base reduces setting availability.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Almost exclusively self-pay; minimal third-party coverage; HSA/FSA may apply in some cases.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Virtually no employer demand in clinical settings; primarily private practice and wellness settings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Clients who complete series report meaningful subjective change.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Almost entirely cash-pay clientele willing to pay premium for sessions.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Established premium brand; $150-250+ per session common.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Distinctive credential, relatively rare, defensible brand identity.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Highly practitioner-dependent; difficult to scale beyond the owner.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Strong in wellness-oriented markets but niche overall.
justifications.business.efficiency: Training is multi-year and expensive — poor efficiency.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Not recognized in PT/OT academia; viewed as alternative bodywork.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Not integrated into mainstream DPT/MOT curricula.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Sparse evidence, mostly small case series.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Years of training for minimal academic return.
